effects.description:
(5 items) Casting a Bone Tyrant ability while in combat grants you Beautiful Corpse and Death's Favor for |cffffff16|r seconds. Death's Favor increases your healing received and reduces damage taken by up to |cffffff12|r% based on your missing Health. This can occur once every |cffffff20|r seconds, and is reduced by |cffffff2|r seconds for each slotted Bone Tyrant ability.

Casting a corpse consumer ability consumes Beautiful Corpse, treating you as a corpse.
